conclusions.subject: design
conclusions.text: Receipt repair re-verified rather than re-decided: the workspace root.yaml (digest c6301010, Version 4) and dispatch.md (30665af9) are byte-identical to the raw I fully reviewed and approved, and the fixed check re-run this attempt returns exit 0. The Design for fmha_tc_main8ws<128,64,2,2,true,false,false,1,false,true,1,false> remains complete and source-faithful with both revision issues closed: (1) all three role Pipes are gated by one uniform if(mrows > 0 and hi > lo) mirroring map_tile's ok at fmha_tc.cu:412, which under this when (splits_ub 1 makes split_range unconditionally true for ok tiles; hi > lo >= kv0 forces nstages >= 1) subsumes all three early returns at 3275/3277/3290, so slack worktiles produce zero action instances exactly as the source does; (2) Math step 3 line 158 states the exact two-case behavior of a fully masked stage (deferred and inert for finite m; at c = 0 the msafe clamp to 0, alpha = 0, mbase(0) = l(0) = 0) equal to fmha_tc.cu:4883-4889, and step 4 line 180 conditions l(C) > 0 on the declared FTZ flush threshold and records the unguarded inv. conclusions.subject: walkthrough
conclusions.text: The end-to-end trace from my full review stands on the identical raw: batch 1, total_q 1500, kv 1500, heads 16/kvh 4 (group 4), d128, page 64, causal, window_left -1, sinks None, lse given. Host: guards pass; total_m 6000 > 64 -> use_tc 1, m_tile 128/n_tile 64; tiles_ub 47, base_blocks 188 >= _target_tc = sm -> splits_ub 1; tiles256 24, 24*4 = 96 < sm -> no DH2 flip; bits 9/26/29 plus rev bit 1 pack as computed; want_maps true so both tensormaps encode; fmha_tc_run takes the 2193 gate then 2219 and launches grid (4,47,1) of 192-thread CTAs with 100992 B, returning without combine. Device, worker 0 (tile_y 0, kvh 0): reversal gives tile 46; map_tile yields b 0, m0 5888, mrows 112, lo 0, hi 1500 -> the guard mrows > 0 and hi > lo is TRUE, kv0 0, stage_count 24; row 0 is token 1472 at head kvh*4 with rhi 1472; rows 112-127 clamp q_idx to 1499, evaluate everything and write nothing; stage 23's rows past 1499 are clamped duplicates masked by rhi. The choreography (prologue key/value(0) + page_id(1); QK(0) prime; per-stage PV(c)-then-QK(c+1) with sfree/pre handshakes; parity P slots; conditional rescale; epilogue after PV(23); closing rendezvous then dealloc) matches the guarded Pipes edge by edge, and 46 full tiles plus the 112-row tail cover all 6000 packed rows once. The empty-work path now walks the document correctly: at total_m 6144 batch 1, tiles_ub is 49 with 48 real tiles, and for tile 48 map_tile returns ok false, so the guard is FALSE and the CTA generates no acquire/load/matmul/epilogue/release instances — exactly the source's return at 3275 before any staging, and last(c) never resolves over an empty domain. Fixed case 9 (q 1025, kv 16385, heads 8/kvh 8) recomputes to splits_ub 4, matching the NCU grid (8,9,4) for the same template and confirming that point belongs to split_kv_prefill, not root.

conclusions.subject: dependencies
conclusions.text: Submission and dependency structure re-confirmed on the identical raw. One Launch of [MAIN], no start_after, no Handoff, matching fmha_tc_run's return without g_combine at splits_ub <= 1 and the single host _launch on the caller's stream; no part_o/part_ml/counter state exists in this scope. Worker_count = kv_head_count*tiles_ub equals the grid product (fold identity in-domain), each worker Preassigned {start: worker_id, count: 1}, Refill none, Exit assigned_done; the Worktile_order flattening (tile_y outer, kv_head inner) matches the CUDA grid linearization with kvh on x. Cross-role edges all map to concrete mbarrier waits: QK(0) <- load:q done (the 3475 rendezvous after cp.async wait) and key(0) done (mbar_kv0 phase 0); PV(c) <- stage_ready(c) (pre parity, 4 warp arrivals after P store and rescale) and value(c) (vv slot); QK(c+1) <- score_region(c) (sfree parity) and key(c+1) (kv slot); score(c) <- QK(c) (mbar_qk parity); rescale(c) <- PV(c-1) (the wait inside the __any_sync guard); epilogue <- PV(last) and release:tmem done <- both last products (the closing syncthreads is safe because those waits already proved the commits). TMA_LEAD's Released edge key/value(c) <- PV(c-2) is sound because the cumulative single-lane commit covering PV(c-2) also covers QK(c-2), the slot's K reader, and the Allowed edge mirrors step (d)'s landing waits before re-arming; the p_tmem parity reuse rides done QK(c) covering PV(c-2), as probability_block's describe records. Out-of-window shifted predecessors (page_id(0); key/value(c-2) at c<2) correspond exactly to the prologue's blocking page form and the init-block arming. The guards change none of these relations for non-empty tiles — all three roles share the same uniform per-CTA condition, so no edge references an instance that exists on one role but not another — and they remove the previously ill-formed empty-domain expansions of last(c).

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: The root reads standalone: all three Design regions are local (checker reports provider root, chain [root] for each), the shared Contract is in-file and unchanged (contract_sha256 identical across rounds), when states the full承担 scope, every bind: (m_tile, n_tile) and ref: (Contract dtypes) resolves within the file, the local alias m = mbase(c-1) is defined in-place at line 154 and used consistently, the guard condition's values (mrows, hi, lo) are defined in Math steps 1-2 and derived at entry per Mapping.Strategy, and no prior-phase knowledge is needed. The when's 'multiprocessor count' and wave targets remain host-plan facts with a definite source, transparently noted against the P1 hardware placeholder.

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: Layering holds: the guards live in Tile_pipeline, where action existence belongs, and use math-layer quantities rather than inventing pipeline-local state; no thread layout, barrier number or instruction entered Math (the msafe/deferred split is stated purely as recurrence cases); Work_schedule still fixes only tile parameters, decomposition and the single submission; the entry-time geometry derivation stays a Mapping.Strategy fact; REALIZATION binds only primitives, launch scale and the residency budget, with no new role, dependency or buffering introduced by the fixes. Storage locations and member units use only P1-registered names.

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: The two prior consistency failures are closed and no new ones exist. The empty-work case is expressed consistently at all three layers: Math ('a tile with mrows == 0 holds no rows at all'), Work_schedule (Thesis 'slack tiles that exit empty', Strategy 'batch_count slack tiles issue no action') and Tile_pipeline (the uniform guards plus Thesis 'an empty tile runs no action'), so declared actions and prose no longer contradict and the last(c) references expand only where stage_count >= 1. Math line 158 agrees with lines 154-155 and with fmha_tc.cu:4883-4889 in both branches, and line 180's positivity claim agrees with the declared FTZ Approx entry and the unguarded inv at 5117-5119. Sizes, tail handling, padding rows, clamped last-stage keys, storage byte totals (256 TMEM columns; 100992 B smem; 192 threads = 4+1+1 warps), the Worktile_order/grid numbering and every view slot_index remain mutually consistent and source-matched.

conclusions.subject: document_relevance
conclusions.text: Content remains necessary and free of process residue: the fixes tightened prose toward the formulas rather than adding narrative; no revision history, TODO or re-litigated decision entered the YAML; the Version bump to 4 is the only metadata change; Ledgers carry only quantified gains and costs; describes stay at design-relevant guarantees; REALIZATION entries all pass the deletion test. dispatch.md (unchanged digest) keeps A/B figures only where they carry a gating default or reachability judgment, and retains the genuine unknown boundaries and research trade-offs required in scope, including the DH2 record whose window-exclusion rationale the revised Math now states precisely.
